창세기 49:1.content: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

창세기 49:2.content: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

창세기 49:3.content: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

창세기 49:4.content: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

창세기 49:5.content: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

창세기 49:6.content: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

창세기 49:7.content: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

창세기 49:8.content: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

창세기 49:9.content: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

창세기 49:10.content: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

창세기 49:11.content: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

창세기 49:12.content: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

창세기 49:13.content: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

창세기 49:14.content: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

창세기 49:15.content: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

창세기 49:16.content: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

창세기 49:17.content: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

창세기 49:18.content: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.

창세기 49:19.content: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

창세기 49:20.content: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

창세기 49:21.content: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

창세기 49:22.content: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

창세기 49:23.content: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

창세기 49:24.content: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

창세기 49:25.content: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

창세기 49:26.content: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

창세기 49:27.content: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

창세기 49:28.content: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

창세기 49:29.content: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

창세기 49:30.content: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

창세기 49:31.content: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

창세기 49:32.content: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

창세기 49:33.content: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
